newsitem.title: CANADA: Banro starts Zaire exploration program.
newsitem.headline: Banro starts Zaire exploration program.

text.p: Banro Resource Corp said on Tuesday it plans to start a major exploration program on its Namoya gold project in Maniema Province in eastern Zaire.

Banro said it was making the announcement in conjunction with the ratification of a new mining convention with the government of Zaire that will increase Banro's ownership of its Zaire holdings to 93 percent. The government will maintain a seven percent carried interest, Banro said.
The convention calls for the transfer of all assets and liabilities of Sominki SARL into a new Zaire company called Sakima SARL, Banro said.

The agreement includes a 10-year tax moratorium from the start of commercial production, the ability to export all gold production and operate in U.S. currency, the elimination of import duties and title confirmation of all concessions, Banro said.
Banro said it has agreed to invest a total of US$15 million, of which about US$5 million has already been credited.
